effects.description: (3 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Dealing damage with an Arcanist ability applies two random status effects to your target and generates a Crux. This effect can occur once every |cffffff7|r seconds. Dealing damage with a Herald of the Tome ability reduces this cooldown by |cffffff0.5|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff1|r second.

Increases your damage done with status effects by |cffffff40|r%.
